title: 第532章 凤族仙山凤血仙池第532章 凤族仙山凤血仙池
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “你们两个，先不要露面了！”
踏入第二层天的刹那，孟尘低头看了一眼脚下。
麒麟始祖与黑龙闻言，纷纷点头。
他们，虽然很想去第二层天逛一逛，但是考虑到自己太招摇，倒也没有多言。
麒麟始祖与黑龙对视一眼，眼中都是不服！
显然，他们对于彼此的地位，感受到了威胁，同为坐骑！
他们之间，必然要有一战！
当下，麒麟始祖与黑龙，直接进入孟尘体内。
以他们的实力，若是在这第二层天直接现身，那磅礴恐怖的气息必然会引起轩然大波，甚至可能引发大恐怖。
孟尘不想惹麻烦，更不想因为自己的到来，搅得这第二层天不得安宁。
于是，唯有他与黎清月两人，在凤七的带领下，踏入了这片广袤无垠的凤族第二天。
第二层天。
当孟尘真正踏入这里的那一刻。
即便是他，也不由得微微驻足。
这里没有第一层仙土那般浩瀚无垠，但放眼望去，天地辽阔，山川壮丽，仙气浓郁得几乎化为实质！
每一次呼吸，都能感受到天地精华在体内流转。
凤族所在的地域，占据了整片大陆。
这片大陆之上，城池林立，星罗棋布，每一座城池都庞大得令人咋舌。
孟尘目光随意一扫，便落在了远处一座巨城之上。
那座城池，城墙高达万丈，以不知名的血石铸就，散发着淡淡的光芒。
城外，各种仙禽异兽随处可见，数以千万计的修士在其中穿梭往来，热闹非常。
这些人，放在下界，随便挑出一个来，都是站在极道领域巅峰的绝世强者。
但在这里，他们只是普通人。
而那些仙禽，也只是他们的普通坐骑而已。
与凡尘之中，百姓豢养的牛马家禽也没有多少区别。
仙界之人，生来便是十三境起步。
这是天道赋予的根基，是仙界与下界最根本的区别。
他看到，那座巨城之中，有人经商，有人交易，有人摆摊售卖仙草，有人开设酒楼招待来客，烟火气十足。
他们虽然修为不弱，但过的却是红尘生活，与凡尘之人并无太大区别。
有人为了一枚仙草的差价，争得面红耳赤。
有人，为了抢购一株稀有的灵草排起了长队，有人在酒楼中推杯换盏，高声谈笑。
content_en:
"You two, don't show your face yet!"
The moment he stepped into the second heaven, Meng Chen lowered his head and glanced at his feet.
Hearing this, Qilin Ancestor and Black Dragon nodded.
Although they wanted to go to the second level for a walk, they didn't say much considering that they were too ostentatious.
The Qilin Ancestor and the Black Dragon looked at each other with dissatisfaction in their eyes!
Obviously, they feel threatened by each other's status, they are both mounts!
There must be a battle between them!
At that moment, the Qilin Ancestor and the Black Dragon entered Meng Chen's body directly.
With their strength, if they appeared directly on this second level of heaven, their majestic and terrifying aura would definitely cause an uproar, and might even trigger a great terror.
Meng Chen didn't want to cause trouble, and he didn't want to disturb the peace of the second world because of his arrival.
So, only he and Li Qingyue, under the leadership of Feng Qi, stepped into the vast second day of the Feng clan.
…
The second heaven.
The moment Meng Chen really stepped here.
Even he couldn't help but pause slightly.
This place is not as vast as the first layer of immortal land, but looking at it, the world is vast, the mountains and rivers are magnificent, and the immortal energy is so strong that it almost turns into substance!
With every breath you take, you can feel the essence of heaven and earth flowing through your body.
The area where the Phoenix Clan is located occupies the entire continent.
On this continent, there are many cities dotted all over the place, and each city is staggeringly huge.
Meng Chen glanced casually and landed on a huge city in the distance.
The city's walls were tens of thousands of feet high, made of unknown bloodstone, and exuded a faint light.
Outside the city, all kinds of immortal birds and animals can be seen everywhere, and tens of millions of monks are shuttled among them, making it very lively.
These people, placed in the lower world and picked at random, are all peerless experts who stand at the pinnacle of the extreme realm.
But here they are just ordinary people.
And those fairy birds are just their ordinary mounts.
It is not much different from the cattle, horses and poultry raised by the common people in the mortal world.
People in the Immortal Realm are born to start in the Thirteenth Realm.
This is the foundation given by heaven and is the most fundamental difference between the fairy world and the lower world.
He saw that in that huge city, some people were doing business, some were trading, some were setting up stalls to sell fairy grass, and some were opening restaurants to entertain visitors, and it was full of fireworks.
Although their cultivation is not weak, they live a mortal life, which is not much different from ordinary people.
Some people were red-faced because of the price difference of a piece of jelly grass.
Some people lined up in a long line to buy a rare spiritual herb, and some people exchanged glasses in the restaurant, chatting and laughing loudly.
